i.norm: countArgs treats the text between the first '(' and the first ')' as a method descriptor's argument list. For an arbitrary string that happens to contain a '(' and a ')', every character in between is counted as a separate argument (no 'L...;' object types are present to be collapsed), giving the raw length of that substring.
